messages: It seems that #p228# in #m010001050# knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.

I met #b#p228##k in #m010001050#. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting and asked me to collect a few items. He said I can get them by defeating #o6#, #o7#, and #o9#, found around #m10001000#. I should try to gather them when I have the time.

I brought the requested items to #p228# in #m010001050# and received a #b#t4080000##k! With this, I can play the Omok mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask #p228# if I want to know more about the mini-game.
name: Make a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set
